headline: The recovered full arc is locally saturated: 14/14 audit items and the innovation reserve shipped, 56 rendered states reviewed, and production held honestly on one Obelisk registration boundary.

items.title: Every fresh audit item and second-order reserve outcome shipped
items.insight: Journey orchestration, intent routing, editorial review, release intelligence, deploy truth, fresh-window analytics, and proof-aware recommendations now form one measured system. The refreshed Genius List has no remaining local implementation item.
items.evidence: AUDIT_2026-08-04 14/14 shipped · four innovation-reserve outcomes · Genius List locally exhausted

items.title: The journey layer was inspected as pixels across every theme and viewport
items.insight: Four touched states across seven themes and desktop/mobile exposed two real light-theme defects. Both were corrected and all 56 states recaptured before the 14 contact-sheet receipt passed.
items.evidence: docs/visual-qa/LATEST.json · 56 raw captures · 14/14 hash-bound sheets · zero blockers

items.title: Production mutation now depends on one hash-chained release ceremony
items.insight: Exact callback validation, two tenant-negative controls, zero-skip three-engine browser proof, deploy quorum, signed Ark dependencies, Doctor, and promotion readiness are consumed as one release authority by all production-mutating workflows.

items.title: Live R2 geo-vitals accrual was restored instead of accepting a stale feed
items.insight: A designated production event proved the producer, then revealed that the builder ignored freshly downloaded untracked rows whenever tracked cache rows existed. Union semantics plus a regression test restored the current 668-sample window.
items.evidence: POST /v/rum 202 · R2 object count increased · geo 21/21 · window through 2026-08-06

items.title: News and Obelisk visibility now have evidence-backed release truth
items.insight: News is intentionally simulated, noindex, and absent from navigation; Obelisk exists in source and staging but the exact callback is unregistered. The newest production probe is challenge-bound/unobserved and the last trustworthy observation was 802 commits / 12.2 days stale, so neither surface should be represented as live yet.

honestyLedger.title: No partial-suite closeout
honestyLedger.why: Changed-path checks accelerate iteration but only the complete measured 283-command manifest can authorize commit and push.
